Bus route 14 to run all night from January

Route 14, which links the hospital with the two largest housing estates in Northmoor, will run through the night from January after a trial that the transport authority described as an unexpected success.

Night-shift workers at the hospital had campaigned for the change for several years, arguing that the last bus at half past eleven left them paying for taxis or walking home along an unlit road.

The authority said the overnight buses would run every forty minutes, with a timetable published next month. The campaigners, who also host a weekly show about the town, told listeners to subscribe to their podcast for updates.

The trial carried more passengers in its first fortnight than the authority had forecast for the whole three months, most of them between midnight and two in the morning.
